verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents defining Fact Tables and metrics so experiment results are computed directly from your own warehouse (docs-9). It is billed as warehouse-native across 11 data sources (gh-3/gh-7), and a community comparison independently confirms it connects to your warehouse rather than requiring events pushed into a walled-garden store (comm-5). missing for 10: explicit evidence for defining metrics from ingested/managed events (only implied by the pricing page's 'no need to connect your data warehouse'), and in-depth detail on how metrics are defined (SQL, metric types).
